title: National Bank of Kazakhstan
subtitle: Perricheno Presentation, Motion Design: the institution behind the tenge, price stability and the payment system.

slides.title: National Bank of *Kazakhstan*
slides.sub: The institution behind the tenge: price stability, financial stability and the payment system.

slides.title: One country, one currency, *one payment space*
slides.lead: From Atyrau to Oskemen, banks and people use the same national currency and the same settlement infrastructure.

items.t: The National Bank issues the tenge and manages banknotes and coins.
It oversees payment systems so transfers settle across every region.
It works to keep prices and the financial system stable.

slides.title: From a new currency to a *floating tenge*
slides.lead: Four moments explain how the National Bank works today.

events.title: Independence
events.t: Kazakhstan starts building its own financial system.

events.title: The tenge
events.t: The national currency is introduced on 15 November, marked every year.

events.title: Free float
events.t: In August the exchange rate begins to float and inflation targeting becomes the framework.

events.title: Digital tenge
events.t: The National Bank starts piloting a digital form of the national currency.

slides.title: How a rate decision *reaches prices*
slides.lead: The base rate is the main instrument. Its effect travels through the economy step by step.

items.t: the base rate sets the price of money for banks.
rates on loans and deposits follow.
households and firms adjust spending and borrowing.
inflation moves toward the target over time.

right.title: Base rate
right.cap: Illustrative gauge, not the current rate

slides.title: Money in every form, *one trusted system*
slides.lead: Cash, cards, QR codes and the digital tenge run on shared rules and shared infrastructure.

left.t: Oversight and clear rules keep payments safe, so trust in the tenge does not depend on the payment method.

items.d: Banknotes and coins issued by the National Bank.
Everyday payments in shops and online.
A digital form of the national currency, in pilot.
Rules and oversight make payments safe.
Banks settle with each other nationwide.
One system from Atyrau to Oskemen.

slides.title: Rate and inflation move together, *with a lag*

left.t: When prices rise faster than the target, the rate goes up first. Inflation reacts later, after loans, spending and expectations adjust.

items.t: Price stability is the main objective.
Policy works over months, not days.

takeaways.title: Price stability
takeaways.t: The main objective behind every rate decision.

takeaways.title: Trusted payments
takeaways.t: One reliable infrastructure for banks and people.

takeaways.title: Ready for what is next
takeaways.t: Digital tenge and instant payments build on the same foundation.
